title: Targeting HER3 with Cooperative miRNAs Enhances Therapeutic Activity in Breast Cancer Cells
author: Lyu, Huang, et al.
materials: Total RNA, including small RNA, was extracted and purified using the miRNeasy Mini Kit (QIAGEN Inc., Valencia, CA, USA) following the manufacturer’s instructions. For miRNA analysis, TaqMan MicroRNA Reverse Transcription kit (Applied Biosystems Inc., Foster City, CA, USA) was first used to generate cDNA with the hairpin primers, which are specific to the mature miRNA and will not bind to the precursors. The expression levels of miR-125a, miR-125b, and miR-205 were then measured by real-time PCR using TaqMan MicroRNA Assays (assay ID: 002198, 000449, 000509, respectively; Applied Biosystems Inc.) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. RNU6B was used as an internal control to normalize all data using the TaqMan RNU6B Assay (assay ID: 001093; Applied Biosystems Inc.). RNU6B levels were unaffected by entinostat treatment. The relative miRNA levels were calculated using the comparative Ct method (ΔΔCt) as described previously [27].

Protein expression levels were determined by western blot analysis as described previously [19, 28]. Equal amounts of total cell lysates were boiled in Laemmli SDS-sample buffer, resolved by SDS-PAGE, transferred to nitrocellulose membrane (Bio-Rad Laboratories, Hercules, CA, USA), and probed with the primary antibodies described in the figure legends. After the blots were incubated with horseradish peroxidase-labeled secondary antibody (Jackson Immuno Research Laboratories, West Grove, PA, USA), the signals were detected using the enhanced chemiluminescence reagents (GE Healthcare Bio-Sciences Corp., Piscataway, NJ, USA).

steps.title: Maintain breast cancer cell lines
steps.instruction: Obtain SKBR3, BT474, and HCC1954 cells from ATCC; confirm identity by DNA profiling; test for mycoplasma every 3 months using the MycoAlert™ Mycoplasma Detection Kit (Lonza); culture cells in DMEM/F‑12 (1:1) medium supplemented with 10 % FBS at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 95 % air and 5 % CO₂; split cultures twice weekly.

substeps.instruction: Culture in specified medium and conditions

steps.title: Extract total RNA including small RNA
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and extract total RNA (including small RNA) using the miRNeasy Mini Kit (QIAGEN) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Synthesize miRNA cDNA
steps.instruction: Use the TaqMan MicroRNA Reverse Transcription kit (Applied Biosystems) with miRNA‑specific hairpin primers to reverse‑transcribe the extracted RNA into cDNA.

steps.title: Quantify miRNA expression by qPCR
steps.instruction: Perform real‑time PCR using TaqMan MicroRNA Assays for miR‑125a (assay ID 002198), miR‑125b (ID 000449), and miR‑205 (ID 000509); include RNU6B (assay ID 001093) as internal control; follow the manufacturer’s protocol; calculate relative miRNA levels with the comparative Ct (ΔΔCt) method.

steps.title: Prepare protein lysates for western blot
steps.instruction: Lyse cells, determine equal protein amounts, mix with Laemmli SDS‑sample buffer, and boil the samples.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE and transfer them onto a nitrocellulose membrane (Bio‑Rad).

steps.title: Probe membrane and detect signal
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with primary antibodies as described in the figure legends; wash; incubate with horseradish peroxidase‑labeled secondary antibody (Jackson Immuno Research); detect signals using enhanced chemiluminescence reagents (GE Healthcare).

steps.title: Analyze cell cycle by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Harvest cells grown in 100‑mm culture dishes, fix with 70 % ethanol, then stain DNA with a solution containing 50 µg/ml propidium iodide and 100 µg/ml RNase I in PBS for 30 min at 37 °C; acquire data on a FAC Scan flow cytometer (BD Biosciences) and determine cell‑cycle distribution.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze experimental data using a two‑sided Student’s t test; consider P < 0.05 significant; report results as mean ± SD from at least three independent experiments.
